purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, bounded request outcomes, scope limits, and safe-field policy for Wonsan.
assessment: No DPRK/Wonsan public cadastral registry, parcel map, current viewer configuration, parcel API, or safe parcel geometry was verified. South Korean K-GeoP is a real first-party cadastral viewer but is outside the requested DPRK jurisdiction.
registryAssessment: No local Wonsan custodian or DPRK national public parcel service was evidenced. General official DPRK web material is not sufficient to mark registryFound true.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official DPRK-domain portal identified during discovery; no cadastral or parcel-map endpoint was identified from the public result.
Official DPRK-domain PDF contains general economic-zone/geographic material and mentions Wonsan as a place on a regional map; it does not publish parcel identities or parcel polygons.
Official Republic of Korea Ministry of Land K-GeoP homepage; jurisdictionally inapplicable to Wonsan/DPRK.
Official Republic of Korea K-GeoP map page exposes Korean land/building and single-parcel controls; no DPRK data was requested or retained.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: No DPRK viewer was located. K-GeoP HTML was retrieved over normal TLS and showed links to /info/infoMap.do and Korean land-information controls, but it is not a DPRK source.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: No DPRK parcel schema or CRS was verified.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: TLS certificate verification failed with curl error 60 (unable to get local issuer certificate); request was not retried with verification disabled and no content was treated as evidence.
HTTP 200; HTML retrieved and cached only under ignored tmp evidence. This is an ROK service, not a DPRK/Wonsan registry; no parcel query was made.
Identified by first-party K-GeoP page/search evidence as an ROK land-information map. No Wonsan/DPRK data or geometry was requested.
Located through official-domain search evidence; not used as a live parcel service and no parcel geometry or unsafe fields were extracted.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying DPRK safe anonymous response was verified.

geometryEvidence.query: No DPRK parcel endpoint was identified for an exact-point query.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No public DPRK parcel service or geometry verified.

remainingUncertainty: A restricted or non-indexed DPRK system may exist. Search non-result, TLS failure, jurisdiction mismatch, and absent geometry do not prove citywide cadastral absence.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent DPRK anonymous ID-plus-geometry response or qualified adapter source.
